notes: AMENDMENTS-014 B68 / AMENDMENTS-015 B78 vendor gating (P4-prep slice). A purchase route (a vendor:<NPC> tag on the item's Cargo Items row) takes part in the §7b derivation only when BOTH halves are honestly derivable: (1) the NPC's availability — `npcs` below, each quoting the NPC article's move-in / appearance rule as registry conditions (none = no progression gate), plus 'has one of these items in the inventory' (`requiresAnyOf`: the minimum over the listed items' own gating — any one suffices) and 'another NPC is present' (`requiresNpcs`); and (2) the item's row in the NPC article's shop table (parse/shops.ts), whose Availability cell must be one of the reviewed `availability` texts. Anything else keeps the route Unknown (gap report blockers vendor-availability-unknown / vendor-conditions-unknown) — never assumed.

Soft move-in requirements that involve no boss and no Hardmode (a vacant house, coins in the inventory, a rescue in a cavern biome, Bestiary completion) are not progression gates and carry no condition; the purchase route already names the NPC.

`unavailable`: vendors whose availability is NOT a single derivable gate set — an OR over several bosses (Dryad, Tavernkeep, Steampunker), a count of other town NPCs (Painter, Party Girl, Dye Trader, Princess), a random visit with a random stock (Traveling Merchant), or an event completion the progression graph does not track as a gate (Santa Claus, Pirate). Their purchase routes stay Unknown; each reason is quoted from the NPC article.

`availability`: verbatim Availability cells (whitespace / link spacing normalized, parse/shops.ts) mapped to registry conditions. Cells naming an OR ("When any mechanical boss has been defeated.", several moon phases), an item in the inventory, another NPC, a world seed, a Party / Christmas / golf score / Bestiary percentage, or a pylon rule are deliberately NOT mapped (Unknown). A mapping that no shop row uses fails the build (stale).
